title: Calendar heatmap of daily activity
when: The user wants a year or months view of daily counts (habits, workouts, commits, sales per day) as colored squares.
prompt:
Goal: A week by weekday grid of days with a stepped color scale, labels, a legend and a text version.
Steps:
1. Aggregate to a Map of "YYYY-MM-DD" to count using local calendar dates, filling every day in range with zeros.
2. Columns are weeks starting on the locale first day, rows are weekdays; 12 px squares with rx 2 on a 14 px pitch.
3. Five steps: zero uses the surface color, quantiles of non zero counts map to 4 tints of one hue, defined as custom properties with dark theme values.
4. Month labels from Intl.DateTimeFormat at each month start; Mon, Wed, Fri row labels.
5. Each rect has a <title> ("3 workouts on 12 Oct 2026"); the grid scrolls sideways on phones with the latest week in view.
6. Legend from Less to More, summary line (total, active days, longest streak), and an aria-label on the svg with the summary.
Quality bar:
- Days never shift from UTC conversion.
- Zero days look distinct from low days.
- Non zero steps reach 3 to 1 against the surface.
Pitfalls:
- toISOString for day keys, which shifts days west of UTC.
- Linear scales where one big day flattens the rest.
- A grid wider than the screen with no scroll container.
Verify:
- [ ] Every day present.
- [ ] Legend and summary shown.
- [ ] svg labeled.
- [ ] Color steps defined for light and dark.
Output: js/heatmap.js exporting calendarHeatmap(container, counts, { start, end }) and heatmap.css.

examples.input: mostrar meus dias de treino do ano em quadradinhos
examples.output: 53 week grid, 5 green steps, legend, "148 active days, longest streak 12"
